title: OpenAI removes the daily limit on free ChatGPT chats and upgrades the default model to GPT-5.6 Luna
excerpt: OpenAI is removing text chat limits for free ChatGPT users and switching the default model to GPT-5.6 Luna, which produces 62% fewer factual errors than GPT-5.5 Instant.
content_html:
TL;DR

OpenAI removes text chat limits for free ChatGPT users. GPT-5.6 Luna becomes the default, with 62% fewer factual errors. Free users get a Think button. Sol gets a reasoning slider for paid users.

OpenAI is removing usage limits on text chats for free ChatGPT users, the company announced on Thursday. The change means free users can send unlimited text-only messages without hitting a daily cap. Limits on image generation, file uploads, and voice tools will still apply. The company is also switching the default model for all users from GPT-5.5 Instant to GPT-5.6 Luna, the lightweight member of the GPT-5.6 family that launched in July after government review.

The accuracy improvement is the headline number. OpenAI says Luna produces 62% fewer factual errors than Instant. Free users and $8/month Go subscribers will also get a new Think button that gives the model more time to process harder questions. Plus and Pro subscribers ($20 and $200/month) get a slider tool on GPT-5.6 Sol, the heavyweight model, that lets them dial reasoning effort from high to extra high to pro depending on the task.

OpenAI said it tweaked Sol for everyday tasks like web research, writing, planning, and decision-making. The model should now give more focused answers with less unnecessary formatting. Luna becomes the default this week, while unlimited chats, the Think button, and the Sol slider roll out next week. ChatGPT crossed one billion monthly users in May, and removing limits for free users is a clear play to keep that base growing rather than losing them to Claude, Gemini, or the growing list of free alternatives.

The safety question is worth noting. Lawsuits against OpenAI have alleged that excessive chatbot use has harmed vulnerable users, including minors. Removing usage limits makes that exposure wider. OpenAI says it has added guardrails so models avoid romantic roleplay, age-restricted challenges, and presenting themselves as substitutes for real-world relationships for users under 18. Whether guardrails are enough when the product now has no off switch for text is a question the courts, not the company, will eventually answer.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

OpenAI 消除了免费 ChatGPT 用户的文本聊天限制。 GPT-5.6 Luna 成为默认值，事实错误减少了 62%。 免费用户可以获得一个“思考”按钮。 Sol 为付费用户提供了推理滑块。

OpenAI 周四宣布，将取消免费 ChatGPT 用户的文本聊天使用限制。 这一变化意味着免费用户可以发送无限量的纯文本消息，而无需达到每日上限。 对图像生成、文件上传和语音工具的限制仍然适用。 该公司还将所有用户的默认模型从 GPT-5.5 Instant 更改为 GPT-5.6 Luna，后者是经过政府审查后于 7 月推出的 GPT-5.6 系列的轻量级成员。

准确性的提高是标题数字。 OpenAI 表示，Luna 产生的事实错误比 Instant 少 62%。 免费用户和每月 8 美元的 Go 订阅者还将获得一个新的 Think 按钮，让模型有更多时间来处理更难的问题。 Plus 和 Pro 订阅者（每月 20 美元和 200 美元）可以在重量级模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 上获得滑块工具，让他们根据任务将推理工作从高调到超高再到专业版。

OpenAI 表示，它针对网络研究、写作、规划和决策等日常任务对 Sol 进行了调整。 该模型现在应该提供更有针对性的答案，并减少不必要的格式。 Luna 本周将成为默认选项，而无限聊天、Think 按钮和 Sol 滑块将在下周推出。 ChatGPT 在 5 月份的月用户数突破了 10 亿，取消免费用户限制显然是为了保持该用户群的增长，而不是让他们输给 Claude、Gemini 或不断增长的免费替代品。

安全问题值得注意。 针对 OpenAI 的诉讼称，过度使用聊天机器人损害了包括未成年人在内的弱势用户。 取消使用限制使这种接触范围更广。 OpenAI 表示，它增加了防护栏，以便模型避免浪漫的角色扮演、年龄限制的挑战，并将自己呈现为 18 岁以下用户的现实世界关系的替代品。 当产品现在没有文本关闭开关时，护栏是否足够，最终将由法院而不是公司来回答。
